name: EF Education First
verdict: Owned by founder Bertil Hult and his family. Nothing found.
note: Swiss-based, Swedish-founded education company founded by Bertil Hult in 1965. Forbes describes EF Education First as Bertil Hult's company, run by his three oldest sons (ef-hult-family-ownership); no state or state fund is in its ownership chain, so nothing passes the METHOD.md test. Title sponsor of the men's (EF Education-EasyPost) and women's (EF Education-Oatly) teams.
